title: Legal
description:
Legal Secretary / Legal Assistant (Conveyancing)

Location: Ipswich

Our client, a well-established and highly regarded law firm, is seeking an experienced Legal Secretary / Legal Assistant to join their busy and successful Conveyancing team. This is an excellent opportunity for a professional who thrives in a fast-paced legal environment and is looking to become part of a supportive and collaborative firm.

The successful candidate will provide vital administrative and legal support to fee earners, helping to ensure residential property transactions progress smoothly from instruction through to completion.

The Role

Key responsibilities will include:
- Providing administrative and secretarial support to Solicitors and Conveyancers.
- Preparing correspondence, legal documents, and forms.
- Opening, maintaining, and closing client files.
- Liaising with clients, estate agents, lenders, and other third parties.
- Managing diaries, appointments, and electronic filing systems.
- Assisting with property searches and Land Registry applications.
- Handling incoming calls and emails professionally and efficiently.
- Supporting the conveyancing process from instruction through to post-completion.

The Ideal Candidate

Our client is looking for someone who can demonstrate:
- Previous experience as a Legal Secretary, Legal Assistant, Conveyancing Assistant, or similar legal support role.
- Experience within Residential Conveyancing is essential
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Outstanding communication and client care skills.
- The ability to manage a busy workload and prioritise effectively.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and legal case management systems.
- A professional, positive, and proactive approach.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary dependent on experience.
- A friendly and supportive working environment.
- Genuine opportunities for career development and progression.
- Ongoing training and professional support.
- The opportunity to join a respected and growing law firm.

If you're an experienced Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant looking for your next challenge within a successful Conveyancing team, we'd love to hear from you.

To apply, please submit your CV to Michelle Topley, email or call

title: Residential Property Legal Secretary
description:
Residential Conveyancing Legal Secretary, Essex - £Up to circa £30k DOE - Are you an experienced Conveyancing Secretary seeking a new challenge in Essex? Working as part of the team you will be providing high-quality secretarial and administrative support to the residential property team. To apply or to register your interest, please contact Cassie on or email with your CV.

JOB TITLE: Residential Property Secretary
PQE: 2+
LOCATION: Essex
SALARY: Up to circa £30k DOE

THE ROLE:
Working as part of a team, you will be providing administrative and secretarial support to the busy residential property team. You will be providing support to the fee earners and be preparing reports, legal documents and forms, audio typing, managing incoming and outgoing correspondence, opening, maintaining and closing client files as well as assisting with the progression of residential property transactions.

THE CANDIDATE:
You must have at least 12 months experience working as a Legal Secretary gained within a reputable practice renowned for their residential property offerings. You will be able to demonstrate a proven track record of assisting with post-completion work, general conveyancing administration and the ability to manage a busy workload while continuing with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

THE FIRM:
Superb opportunity to join a supportive team within a well established and respected Essex based practice.

HOW TO APPLY:
Contact Cassie Huxtable at eNL on or email with your CV, or simply call for a confidential discussion.

eNL will never share your CV with a third party without your express permission. As part of our candidate care process, we aim to respond to all applications in 7 days. If you have not been contacted within this timescale, your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion. Please note our advertisements use PQE/salary levels purely as a guide.

At eNL we value diversity and inclusion. We want to attract people at all levels and encourage applications from all suitably qualified candidates whatever your ethnicity, religion, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any characteristics protected by law in the jurisdictions in which we operate.
